decision: build the units that can be proven locally first (domain model, builder image), leave remote units gated
why: no Cloudflare token in this shell; Artifacts and dispatch namespaces have no local emulation

decision: skipped a multi-model design bakeoff for the overall shape
why: the architecture doc already settles the design; what is open are API facts, settled by research

decision: build sandbox becomes our own DO on Sandbox SDK 1.0, not getSandbox()
why: SDK 1.0 (2026-09-30) removed getSandbox and string exec

decision: fetch source by walking Artifacts readTree/readBlob in the Workflow; commit via isomorphic-git
why: Artifacts has no tarball endpoint and no commit method; keeps credentials out of the sandbox

decision: build requests dedupe on building or pending sha only; a deployed sha rebuilds only when asked to rebuild
why: the doc says a deployed sha is a no-op, but template upgrades rebuild deployed_sha; the two rules conflict

decision: site names live in apps/api for now, no shared package until the dispatch worker needs them
why: one consumer today; a package with one caller is a layer with no payoff

decision: landed the sites domain model: names, hostname parsing, sites and hostnames tables, sites.create/list, build coordinator
why: local scaffold every later unit uses

decision: build state is one coordinator per site with one id sequence; ids are siteId--target--seq
why: a DO has one alarm, and the doc's single-hyphen ids can collide (acme+pr-1 vs acme-pr+1)

decision: a missing workflow instance restarts the build instead of failing it
why: the doc records the id before create, so missing means create never ran; failing would drop the publish

decision: reserved the preview slug
why: a site at preview.shiru.sh could set cookies for every preview host

decision: landed apps/builder: Nimbus template, docs.config.json v1, build-site, Dockerfile on node 24 + sandbox-shim 1.0.0
why: proves the riskiest local unknown, an offline astro build in the sandbox image
result: verify.sh 34/34 rerun by me; image 825 MB; build 2.7s cold, 2.0s warm (measured here)

decision: MDX check uses satteri, the parser Astro compiles with, not micromark
why: a separate parser could read a page differently from the compiler

decision: client pages can still run script tags on <slug>.shiru.sh, which shares the cookie domain with the dashboard
why: plain JSX elements are allowed in MDX; README says prod cookies are shared across .shiru.sh
result: open, needs a product call on the docs domain

decision: Nimbus emits /<path>/index.md, PRODUCT.md promises /<path>.md
why: found by the unit 2 build
result: open, fix in the dispatch or site worker

decision: docs sites move to their own registrable domain, set from config
why: operator chose it; client scripts must not share cookies with the dashboard

decision: keep Nimbus's /<path>/index.md Markdown URLs
why: operator chose the Nimbus default over the /<path>.md promise

decision: allow any MDX Nimbus accepts; drop the import/export/expression checks from build-site
why: operator chose it; the sandbox has no credentials or network and the docs domain is isolated
